title: Construct a positive rank-one covariance complement
source_anchor: Pinned OAI adc7f124, implementation.tex blob27a4a2ed, lem:compiler-absorption covariance identity. Authored rank-one construction prerequisite, not the full source lemma.
target_statement: For a real complete inner-product space E and u:E with ||u||<=1, there exists P:E->L[R]E such that P.IsPositive and P.adjoint.comp P + rankOne R u u = id R E. This produces the actual covariance complement; its existence is not assumed.

proof_route: Put a=sqrt(1-||u||^2), c=1/(1+a), P=id-c rankOne(u,u). Denominator >=1, so no zero-vector division.
Adjoint rankOne self proves self-adjoint P.
RankOne composition and scalar identity give P*P+rankOne(u,u)=id.
